'''''Life Day Painting''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] available after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It was part of a series of five paintings, alongside ''[[Kashyyyk at Night]]'', ''[[Proud Wookiee]]'', ''[[Red Robed Wookiee]]'', and ''[[Gift Giving Wookiees]]'', that were made for the festivities of [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]]. The painting in question depicted two adult [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] adorning a Life [[Standard day/Legends|Day]] [[Robe/Legends|robes]], holding a Wookiee pup also wearing a Life Day robe. It was supplied during the events of an annual Life Day celebration on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].

==Behind the scenes==
This painting, alongside ''Kashyyyk at Night'', ''Proud Wookiee'', ''Red Robed Wookiee'' and ''Gift Giving Wookiees'', were supplied during the 2006 Wookiee Life Day festivities.
